034public class DomainGradePartsPlugin implements CommodityTooltipModifier, ShowLootListener {
035
036        public static float BASE_DP = Global.getSettings().getFloat("partsSalvageBaseDP");
037        public static float DP_EXPONENT = Global.getSettings().getFloat("partsSalvageDPExponent");
038        public static float MIN_DP_PER_SHIP = Global.getSettings().getFloat("partsSalvageMinDPPerShip");
039        
040        public static float DMOD_REDUCTION = Global.getSettings().getFloat("partsReductionAtFiveDmods");
041        
042        
043        public static boolean useModifiedDropRate() {
044                return Global.getSettings().getBoolean("partsUseModifiedDropRate");
045        }
046        
047        public static float getPostBattleDropRateMult() {
048                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
049                if (fleet == null) return 1f;
050
051                float val = 1f;
052                if (useModifiedDropRate()) {
053                        float dp = BaseSkillEffectDescription.getTotalOP(fleet.getFleetData(), Global.getSector().getPlayerStats());
054                        float ships = fleet.getNumShips();
055                        dp = Math.max(ships * MIN_DP_PER_SHIP, dp);
056                        if (dp < BASE_DP) dp = BASE_DP;
057                        val = (float) (Math.pow(BASE_DP, DP_EXPONENT) / Math.pow(dp, DP_EXPONENT));
058                }
059                val *= fleet.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.DOMAIN_GRADE_PARTS_DROP_RATE_MULT);
060                return val;
061        }
062        
063        public static float getNormalDropRateMult() {
064                if (!useModifiedDropRate()) return 1f;
065                
066                float dp = 240f;
067                if (dp < BASE_DP) dp = BASE_DP;
068                float val = (float) (Math.pow(BASE_DP, DP_EXPONENT) / Math.pow(dp, DP_EXPONENT));
069                //val = 1f;
070                return val;
071        }
072        
073        public static float getNormalizedDropRate() {
074                float rate = getPostBattleDropRateMult();
075                float normalRate = getNormalDropRateMult();
076                float rateAsMultiplier = rate / normalRate;
077                return rateAsMultiplier;
078        }

081        @Override

083                // I apologize for putting this code here -am
084                if (Misc.isExtended() && stack != null && stack.isPersonnelStack()) {
085                        info.addPara("The number of personnel available for hire at a submarket depends greatly on your relationship "
086                                        + "with its faction.", 10f);
087                        return;
088                }
089                
090                if (!Commodities.PARTS.equals(stack.getCommodityId())) return;
091                
092                float opad = 10f;
093                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
094
095                CommoditySpecAPI parts = Global.getSettings().getCommoditySpec(Commodities.PARTS);
096                String name = Misc.ucFirst(parts.getName().toLowerCase());
097                
098                if (useModifiedDropRate()) {
099                        LabelAPI heading = info.addSectionHeading("Post-battle salvage rate", 
100                                        Misc.getBasePlayerColor(), Misc.getDarkPlayerColor(), Alignment.MID, opad);
101                        heading.autoSizeToWidth(info.getTextWidthOverride());
102                        PositionAPI p = heading.getPosition();
103                        p.setSize(p.getWidth(), p.getHeight() + 3f);
104                        
105                        float rate = getPostBattleDropRateMult();
106                        int ratePct = (int)Math.round(rate * 100f);
107                        String rateStr = "" + ratePct + "%";
108                        if (ratePct <= 0) {

110                        }
111        
112                        boolean showAsMult = false;
113                        showAsMult = true;

127                                                "" + (int) Math.round(BASE_DP), "" + maxShips);
128                                
129                                info.addPara("Current chance of finding " + name + ": %s normal.", opad, h, rateStr);                   
130                        } else {
131                                info.addPara("Identifying critical parts during salvage operations requires an intimate knowledge of the ships "
132                                                + " that need repairs, and generally becomes less and less practical as the size of a fleet grows. "
133                                                + "The rate of finding " + name + " is at its maximum when the fleet has %s or less total "
134                                                + "deployment points, and consists of %s or fewer ships.", opad, h,
135                                                "" + (int) Math.round(BASE_DP), "" + maxShips);
136                                
137                                info.addPara("Current rate of finding " + name + ": %s", opad, h, rateStr);
138                        }
139                }
140
141                
142                LabelAPI heading = null;
143                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
144                        heading = info.addSectionHeading("D-mod repairs & ship value", 
145                                        Misc.getBasePlayerColor(), Misc.getDarkPlayerColor(), Alignment.MID, opad);
146                } else {
147                        heading = info.addSectionHeading("D-mod repairs", 
148                                        Misc.getBasePlayerColor(), Misc.getDarkPlayerColor(), Alignment.MID, opad);
149                }
150                heading.autoSizeToWidth(info.getTextWidthOverride());
151                PositionAPI p = heading.getPosition();
152                p.setSize(p.getWidth(), p.getHeight() + 3f);
153
154                info.addPara("Repairing d-mods on larger and more expensive hulls generally requires more parts.", opad);
155                
156                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
157                        int perPart = Global.getSettings().getInt("ext_shipSellValueIncreasePerPartUsed");
158                        info.addPara("A ship that had d-mods removed using " + name + " will have its resale value "

160                                        + "the number of d-mods the hull currently has.", opad, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(perPart), "5");
161                        
162                        float perSMod = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_shipSellValueMultPerSMod");
163                        if (perSMod > 0) {
164                                info.addPara("Ships with s-mods have their resale value greatly increased, including the portion "
165                                                + "of the value that comes from " + name + ".", opad,
166                                                Misc.getStoryOptionColor(), "s-mods");
167                        }
168                }
169                
170                // specified per-hull now, not per size clas
171                if (false) {
172                        List<HullSize> sizes = new ArrayList<>();
173                        sizes.add(HullSize.FRIGATE);
174                        sizes.add(HullSize.DESTROYER);
175                        sizes.add(HullSize.CRUISER);
176                        sizes.add(HullSize.CAPITAL_SHIP);
177                        
178                        FactionAPI f = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction();
179                        float colW = 170f;
180                        info.beginTable(f, 20f, "Hull size", colW, "Parts per d-mod", colW + 0f);

182                        String costStr;
183                        costStr = "" + (int) Global.getSettings().optFloatFromArray("dModRepairCostInParts", HullSize.FRIGATE.ordinal() - 2, 1);

187                        info.addRow(Alignment.MID, h, "Destroyer", Alignment.MID, h, costStr);
188                        
189                        costStr = "" + (int) Global.getSettings().optFloatFromArray("dModRepairCostInParts", HullSize.CRUISER.ordinal() - 2, 1);
190                        info.addRow(Alignment.MID, h, "Cruiser", Alignment.MID, h, costStr);
191                        
192                        costStr = "" + (int) Global.getSettings().optFloatFromArray("dModRepairCostInParts", HullSize.CAPITAL_SHIP.ordinal() - 2, 1);
193                        info.addRow(Alignment.MID, h, "Capital", Alignment.MID, h, costStr);
194                        
195                        info.addTable("", 0, opad);

198                        prev.getPosition().setXAlignOffset(xOff);

203        public static float getPartsPerUnitOfSupplies() {
204                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
205                        return Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_partsPerUnitOfSupplies");
206                }
207                return Global.getSettings().getFloat("partsPerUnitOfSupplies");
208        }
209
210        @Override
211        public void reportAboutToShowLootToPlayer(CargoAPI loot, InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
212                if (loot == null) return;
213                
214                if (!Misc.usePartsBasedDModRepairs()) {
215                        for (CargoStackAPI stack : loot.getStacksCopy()) {
216                                if (Commodities.PARTS.equals(stack.getCommodityId())) {
217                                        loot.removeStack(stack);
218                                }
219                        }
220                        return;
221                }
222                
223                
224                if (dialog == null) return;
225                SectorEntityToken target = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
226                if (target == null) return;
227                
228                // target is a fleet when getting loot from fighting automated defenses
229                // and the snapshots are set
230                // likewise for a regular battle
231                
232                float mult = getPartsPerUnitOfSupplies();
233                BattleAPI battle = null;
234                if (target instanceof CampaignFleetAPI && ((CampaignFleetAPI) target).getBattle() != null) {
235                        battle = ((CampaignFleetAPI) target).getBattle();
236                } else {
237                        battle = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getBattle();
238                }
239                if (battle != null) {
240                        mult *= getPostBattleDropRateMult();
241                        
242//                      CampaignFleetAPI fleet = (CampaignFleetAPI) target;
243//                      BattleAPI battle = fleet.getBattle();
244                        
245                        //float f = battle.getPlayerInvolvementFraction();
246                        //mult *= f; // already accounted for by the amount of supplies
247                        
248                        // this does not take into account ships that were recovered
249                        // just getting an approximate value for the amount of d-mods on the destroyed
250                        float dmodWeight = 0f;
251                        float traderWeight = 0f;
252                        float memberWeight = 0f;
253                        for (CampaignFleetAPI curr : battle.getSnapshotBothSides()) {
254                                boolean trader = Misc.isTrader(curr);
255                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : Misc.getSnapshotMembersLost(curr)) {
256                                        float weight = member.getDeploymentPointsCost();
257                                        float dmods = DModManager.getNumDMods(member.getVariant());
258                                        memberWeight += weight;
259                                        dmodWeight += dmods * weight;
260                                        if (trader) {
261                                                traderWeight += weight;
262                                        }
263                                }
264                        }
265                        float averageDmods = dmodWeight / Math.max(1f, memberWeight);
266                        float fraction = averageDmods / 5f;
267                        if (fraction < 0f) fraction = 0f;
268                        if (fraction > 1f) fraction = 1f;
269                        
270                        float dModMult = 1f - fraction * (1f - DMOD_REDUCTION);
271                        mult *= dModMult;
272                        
273                        if (traderWeight > 0f) {
274                                float traderMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("partsDropMultFromTradeFleets");
275                                float traderFraction = (traderWeight / Math.max(1f, memberWeight));
276                                if (traderFraction > 1f) traderFraction = 1f;
277                                float nonTraderFraction = 1f - traderFraction;
278                                if (nonTraderFraction > 1f) nonTraderFraction = 1f;
279                                
280                                traderMult = nonTraderFraction + traderFraction * traderMult;
281                                
282                                if (traderMult < 0f) traderMult = 0f;
283                                if (traderMult > 1f) traderMult = 1f;
284                                mult *= traderMult;
285                        }
286                        
287                } else {
288                        if (!target.hasTag(Tags.SALVAGEABLE)) {
289                                return;
290                        }
291                        
292                        mult *= getNormalDropRateMult();
293                }
294                
295                float supplies = loot.getSupplies();
296                float parts = mult * supplies;
297                
298                Random random = Misc.getRandom(Misc.getSalvageSeed(target) * Global.getSector().getPlayerBattleSeed(), 17);
299                
300                int partsToAdd = 0;
301                
302                if (parts < 1f) {
303                        if (random.nextFloat() < parts) {
304                                partsToAdd++;
305                        }
306                } else if (parts < 20f) {
307                        for (float f = 0; f <= parts; f += 0.5f) {
308                                if (random.nextFloat() < 0.5f) {
309                                        partsToAdd++;
310                                }       
311                        }
312                } else {
313                        parts = parts * (0.5f + random.nextFloat());
314                        partsToAdd += (int) Math.round(parts);
315                }
316                
317                loot.addCommodity(Commodities.PARTS, partsToAdd);
318        }
